snippet.description:
Was This Ancient Egyptian Object a Tool, Instrument, or Something Else?

An unusual object appears in this ancient Egyptian wall carving, held by a standing figure whose purpose remains a mystery. 

Its distinctive shape raises intriguing questions about what it might have represented in the ancient world. Was it a practical tool, a musical instrument, a ceremonial object, or something entirely different? 

Every detail of this carving offers another clue to explore. 

What do you think this mysterious object was used for?
